definitions.explanation: An alphabetical list of topics, names, etc. at the end of a book, with references to the pages where they appear.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}の{巻末|かんまつ}に{索引|さくいん}がある。
examples.english: There is an index at the end of the book.

examples.japanese: {索引|さくいん}を{使|つか}って{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked it up using the index.

examples.japanese: {五十音|ごじゅうおん}{順|じゅん}の{索引|さくいん}になっている。
examples.english: It is an index in Japanese alphabetical order.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{索引|さくいん}を{引|ひ}く (to look up in an index)
・{索引|さくいん}を{作|つく}る (to create an index)
・{索引|さくいん}{付|つ}き (indexed)

RELATED TERMS:
・{目次|もくじ} (table of contents)
・{巻末|かんまつ}{索引|さくいん} (back-of-book index)
